topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I don’t know what went wrong, but something did. All those whispers, the secretive smiles, the笔记本被藏起来的角落 — everything pointed to something good. And then, silence. Nothing. I saw the texts, the deleted messages, the clear signs of a plan in shambles. They say it was for my own good, to avoid the rush, the inconvenience. But now there’s just a void where the excitement used to be. I don’t get it. I keep thinking about all the effort, the promises, the anticipation. It’s like a promise broken, a trail that led nowhere. I can’t shake the feeling that I’ve been left out in the cold, waiting for something that will never come.
